about: The secrets drop. scripts/secrets.sh reads this file. docs/secrets_drop.md says what each field does and how to add an entry. No value lives here, only names, paths and prefilled public settings. The order matters: push --all pushes in this order, so the public key goes before backup-offbox and its post-push check.

entries.name: backup-gpg-public
entries.notes: The PUBLIC key that the backup encrypts to. scripts/secrets.sh gen backup-gpg writes it. The push refuses a file that holds a private key.

entries.name: backup-offbox

key_notes.BACKUP_S3_REGION: This is a guess. Check in dashboard: Storage, S3 Connection shows the region.
key_notes.BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: From Storage, S3 Connection in the Supabase dashboard.
key_notes.BACKUP_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: The dashboard shows the secret one time only. The key is project-wide.
key_notes.BACKUP_GPG_RECIPIENT: scripts/secrets.sh gen backup-gpg fills this key for you.
key_notes.BACKUP_S3_PREFIX: Optional. The folder in the bucket. Default nightly.
key_notes.BACKUP_S3_KEEP: Optional. Complete nights to keep in the bucket. Default 14.
key_notes.BACKUP_S3_TIMEOUT_SECS: Optional. The deadline of the off-box step, in seconds. Default 1200.
key_notes.BACKUP_REMOTE: Optional. An rsync destination, user@host:path. Empty means no rsync copy.
key_notes.BACKUP_PG_HOST: Optional but advised. The PGHOST of the app database. A root backup refuses any other server.
key_notes.BACKUP_PG_USER_SUFFIX: Optional but advised. The .<ref> end of POSTGRES_USER, or the whole user. A root backup refuses any other.
key_notes.BACKUP_CC_PG_HOST: Optional but advised. The host in CUSTOMER_CONSOLE_DATABASE_URL.
key_notes.BACKUP_CC_PG_USER_SUFFIX: Optional but advised. The .<ref> end of the Console user, or the whole user.

entries.notes: The off-box backup key (H-123). Only acb-backup.service loads this file. backup_offbox.sh refuses a file that is not root:root 0600. Never put these keys in the app env.

entries.name: app-env
entries.notes: The app env file. acb-gateway and acb-whatsapp-bridge load it. The allowed list is EMPTY on purpose, so nothing goes in by accident. To add a key, add its name to allowed_keys in a reviewed change. Never add a BACKUP_ key here. rebuild_root_env: after the write, the push writes /etc/acb/root.env again on the box (WS-49 BH-6), so the root units see the new value with no deploy.

local_only.name: backup-gpg-private
local_only.notes: The private backup key and its passphrase. They never go to the box. Copy both into your password manager, then run scripts/secrets.sh forget backup-gpg-private.
